item.title: Biofeedback & Multisensory Immersion in VR (Master's Thesis)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An R&D environment investigating physiological correlations between human biometrics and subjective VR/PC flow states, featuring ESP32 telemetry, a custom Olfactory Display, and Python data science.

item.title: Experiencing Immersion in Virtual Realities & Techniques for Deepening Presence (OCETA 2025)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: A conference talk delivered at OCETA exploring embodied presence in XR, physiological biometric measurements of immersion, and practical techniques for spatial depth.

item.title: VR Simulator "Rouge Squadron" & Biometric Research
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An advanced cooperative VR spaceship simulator (LAN Multiplayer / Netcode) paired with clinical biometric research measuring player stress (EDA) and presence in VR.
